title: Book Translator (KazKozDev)
summary: Localhost-focused book translator supporting TXT/EPUB/PDF/DOCX input, glossary and resumable book workflows, with Ollama model integration per project docs.
documentation_observations: README states app/glossary/jobs run locally with SQLite.
README notes scanned PDFs require OCR first, and Ollama Cloud models upload text; locality depends on model choice.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
